claim_ceiling: THE HIGHEST-VALUE ROW IN THIS MAP, for a structural reason, and the one row that has since been taken to its conclusion. E_KLF12_HIGH is one of only five hand-set FREE variables in v0.4 and the only one scRNA can observe -- the other four are interface relays with no cellular correlate. Being free, it takes an initial-state prior DIRECTLY, with no rule override. The pre-registered attempt to supply that prior is docs/scrna/klf12_prior_preregistration.md and its result is docs/scrna/klf12_prior_finding.md: these data do not establish a measured prior for E_KLF12_HIGH -- a limit of what the measurement identifies, NOT a finding that no KLF12-high state exists. A two-component mixture on the 3,429 detected cells fits, but whether it passes M1(a) depends on which reading of the frozen sentence is applied: the implemented rule (exactly one posterior crossing inside the fitted support, between the means) says no, while the two readings closer to the pre-registered wording propose boundaries of 1.06 and 1.17 transcript-equivalents and say yes. That rule is POST-HOC and is labelled as such. F3 is loose in the same way and pulls the other way, so the pre-registered decision branch is NOT uniquely determined: crossing the two ambiguities reaches GO, CONDITIONAL_GO and NO_GO alike, and the artifact commits the whole grid. Nothing was activated under any cell. What rules a measured prior out under every cell is specificity, not wording: all three M1(a) readings, and M1(b), also pass on a population simulated with no latent state at all, 25 of 25 replicates. That calibration covers M1(a) and M1(b) only; M1(c) and the falsifiers need per-unit structure the null does not model. The multimodality the detected values do have is the integer UMI lattice (modes at 0.97, 1.91, 2.79, 3.77, 4.72, 5.92, 6.88 transcript-equivalents). The pre-registered raw-UMI sensitivity was run (docs/scrna/klf12_raw_umi_findings.json) and agrees: on integer counts 65.5% of detected cells carry exactly one UMI and the median detected value is one molecule in every one of the six units. No latent-state model is fitted on the raw layer: an earlier revision compared a two-component gamma-Poisson mixture against a single-rate model by BIC, and that analysis was REMOVED because the likelihood is multimodal, three successive fitters each returned a demonstrable non-maximum, and the reported gain moved +17.0 to +10.24 to +21.52 as the search was hardened; it was never load-bearing. Model-free, thinning to the lowest unit median (14,503 UMIs) and recounting on the cells that were actually matched -- the scheme the artifact records as depth_matched_scheme_for_per_unit = matched_cells_only, because thinning cannot raise a cell already below the target -- cuts the between-unit spread in KLF12 detection from 0.330 to 0.229 and reverses the HT-versus-CNT sign within donor SZ25 (+0.102 crude, -0.118 depth-matched), the same reversal seen by standardisation on the corrected layer. That scheme is not free and its cost is uneven in the direction opposite to the intuition: the unmatched (dropped) share is 4.1% for SZ25TE_HT, which keeps 1,346 of its 1,404 cells, against 36.3-50.0% for the other five, so the deep unit retains almost everything and the shallow units pay. Three POST-HOC findings sit beside that pre-registered one: the pooled 75th and 80th percentile thresholds are exactly zero and so collapse onto bare detection; the HT-versus-CNT difference changes sign depending on whether sequencing depth or epithelial subtype is adjusted for, with both adjustments putting 20-43% of their weight on strata of 3-38 cells; and subtype adjustment partly removes the condition itself, because three of the four epithelial labels are ~80% one arm. Conditioning was executed anyway, as a declared arbitrary-threshold sensitivity sweep, and its only finding is structural: at the converged horizon every tracked quantity is the two-extreme mixture (1-p)*value(0) + p*value(1) to within 6.0e-4 -- NOT the special case 'unconditioned value scaled by 1 - prior', which is false for E_KLF12_HIGH itself, for E_ITGAVB3_5 and for OUT_STROMAL_DECIDUALIZED. So this row stays provisional and the external asset stays not-integrated. What would lift it is a reference population for 'high' or a KLF12 assay with dynamic range, not more analysis of these 28,212 cells.
